repository.name: bagronlab
repository.description: Monorepo con la suite oficial de librerías y utilidades para Bagron
repository.author: Discentra Community

gnulibrary.description: Linux x86_64 raw syscalls and shared Linux constants

windows.description: Native Microsoft Windows x64 ABI declarations and WinSock sockets

io.description: Standard text and byte input/output helpers for Bagron

hashlib.description: Hashing algorithms implemented natively in Bagron

os.description: Portable operating system file, filesystem, and process APIs

time.description: Portable monotonic clocks, durations, UTC date-time, and formatting

androidlib.description: Native Android AArch64 syscall and runtime declarations

x11gui.description: Linux X11 window, event, drawing, and control helpers
